experiences.description: Architected multi-tier virtualization environments using Proxmox VE with segmented VLANs and firewall policies. Configured Microsoft Entra ID and Intune policies for endpoint security and automated onboarding, while deploying Zabbix and GLPI for proactive network telemetry and asset tracking.

Facilitated workshops, in-class activities, and icebreakers to foster an engaging and collaborative learning environment. Represented CodePath at Georgia State University events, increasing program visibility and driving student enrollment.

Engineered a native Android application to generate, emit, and capture high-frequency audio chirps for bio-acoustic signal sensing. Implemented precise audio sweep logic and lossless recording pipelines using native AudioRecord APIs, achieving high signal capture reliability for downstream signal processing and analysis.

Elevated student assessment performance by 15% for a 20-student cohort by delivering targeted debugging protocols and conceptual frameworks in Data Structures & Algorithms. Provided technical code reviews on 50+ assignments and engineered a one-letter-grade average improvement through systematic troubleshooting guidance.

Led a team of 3 developers to launch the GSU SHPE chapter's online presence, securing $1,500 in sponsorships. Assisted 10+ members with Python assignments in Data Structures & Algorithms and System-Level Programming.

Monitored 50 client systems to ensure optimal functionality and prevent downtime. Managed help desk operations and created 10 error resolution guides to improve troubleshooting workflows. Resolved 50+ system issues and provided ongoing technical support.

Completed 5 websites for small businesses, increasing online visibility by 30%. Set up optimized SEO strategies and enabled email subscription systems to enhance client outreach. Delivered custom solutions using WordPress, Squarespace, and modern web frameworks.
